title: Efficacy and Safety of ReLEx Smile for Laser Correction of Myopia
brief_summary: Evaluation of the safety and efficacy of the Carl Zeiss Meditec VisuMax femtosecond laser for lamellar resection (ReLEx smile) in the reduction of myopia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Indication for keratorefractive correction of myopia
* Patient consent to undergo keratorefractive correction of myopia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or lactating women
study_population: Patients referred to the Department of Ophthalmology, Aarhus University Hospital, for keratorefractive surgical correction of myopia
